prose.name: Hauling: The Rounds on <Planet>
prose.briefing: The medic at the <Place> is short-handed and has a patient elsewhere in this system who needs her medicine today.
prose.card: I'm short-handed, and my patient in this system needs her medicine today. The case is at the <Place>.

beats.name: Medicine Case
beats.objective: Collect the medicine case at the <Place>
beats.journal: I've got the medicine case from the <Place>. I need to take it to the patient at the <SecondPlace>.
say: That's the case. She takes two a day, tell her I said so.

beats.objective: Deliver the medicine to the patient at the <SecondPlace>

person.name: Rosa Feld
hellos: Is that my medicine? Oh, good.

_bio.from: the medic's patient, on medicine for a cough that came back (her lines)
_bio.why_there: home, waiting on her medicine (the briefing)
_bio.wants: company, mostly; and someone to look in on the old miner (her lines)

greeting: You're not my medic. Is that my medicine? She's short-handed again, isn't she.

exchanges.prompt: Your medicine. Two a day, she says.
reply: Two a day. I know. She tells me every time. Thank you, love. While you're doing her rounds, would you look in on the old miner? Nobody's heard from him in days.

exchanges.prompt: How long have you been on it?
reply: Since the cough came back. You know what this is, then. Don't tell me, I'd rather not.

exchanges.prompt: Is there anything else you need?
reply: Company, mostly. You've done your bit. Sit for a minute if you like.

beats.journal: I took the medic's case from the <Place> to her patient at the <SecondPlace>, and stayed for a minute.

broadcast: I'm short-handed and my patient can't wait. The case is ready to go. Mind it, it rattles.
_speech: Overworked and grateful. A stand-in voice; his ear decides.

reply: Bless you. He won't thank you for it, but he'll be glad somebody came.
